provenance.notes: Challenge-tier halogen-debut set (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 7, APPROVED 2026-09-26): chloramphenicol CID 5959 (C11H12Cl2N2O5, 20 heavy, Charge 0 - the bundle's halogen DEBUT via 2x C-Cl; chlorine compound, correctly NOT fluoro - C-F excluded per DETECT-03) + quinine CID 3034034 (C20H24N2O2, 24 heavy, neutral free base as-registered - quinuclidine N unprotonated). No alternates for either row. Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID <CID>; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/<CID>'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human PHYSIOLOGICAL-PROTONATION decision '2 go R1-R8, 3 +1' - the '3 +1' clause is the EXPLICIT +1-cation choice for the quinine marginal row, audit row 12/R8, directive: 'per our spec we want to assume physiological pH normally'): quinine CID 3034034 neutral free base -> quinuclidinium(+1) CID 6999115 (quinuclidine NH+ protonated, 93.5% at pH 7.4 via pKa 8.56 PubChem AID 781325/781326 SID 103401549; stereo pattern identical to shipped natural quinine; details in the entry note). Quinine salts (e.g. CID 91558) REJECTED per the bare-species law.

Chloramphenicol, PubChem CID 5959 (C11H12Cl2N2O5, 20 heavy, Charge 0 as recorded; approval-time re-verification MATCH 2026-09-26, counts 32/32). Complex: 4CLA chloramphenicol acetyltransferase-chloramphenicol - the resistance enzyme complex, canonical named entry (CLM confirmed in nonpolymer inventory; CO ion also present, 2026-09-26); entry DOI resolves 200; primary paper DOI 10.1021/bi00229a025 VERIFIED at rcsb.org (doi.org = 403 bot-block, U2 - recorded at rcsb and transcribed honestly). THE BUNDLE'S HALOGEN DEBUT: 2x C-Cl donors - first real-data exercise of the detector's halogen branch (02-07b row 6; Cl in the approved donor list, C-F excluded per DETECT-03). Also h_bond (2 OH donors + amide N-H donor; nitro/amide/OH oxygen acceptors), pi_stacking (nitrophenyl), hydrophobic. Feeds Decision 8 (DETECT-03 revisit trigger, headless coverage check lives in 08-11).

Quinuclidinium quinine, PubChem CID 6999115 (C20H25N2O2+, 24 heavy, Charge +1 as recorded - quinuclidine N protonated, bare cation single component; stereo pattern identical to the shipped natural quinine CID 3034034 by IUPAC-name comparison, audit receipt). Complex: 4WNV Human Cytochrome P450 2D6 Quinine Complex (a PROTEIN target - the human ruled 9NDX's RNA aptamer the wrong reference class for an amino-acid game; QI9 'Quinine' confirmed in the RCSB nonpolymer inventory via the data API 2026-10-04). Interaction profile: salt_bridge (the +1 quinuclidinium vs AA carboxylates - the marginal-protonation teaching case), h_bond (OH donor; methoxy O + quinoline N acceptors; the NH+ also types '+' structurally), pi_stacking (quinoline fused rings), hydrophobic STRONG (quinuclidine cage) - the alkaloid/hydrophobic-heavy contrast to the h_bond-rich sets; largest carbon framework in the small bucket. NO halogen/metal flags (element scan false/false - the set's flag contrast to chloramphenicol UNCHANGED). AMENDED 2026-10-05 (human decision '2 go R1-R8, 3 +1' - the EXPLICIT +1-cation choice for the marginal row, audit row 12/R8): was CID 3034034 neutral free base (48/51 {1:45,2:6} chg 0, approval-time re-verification MATCH 2026-09-26); swapped to the quinuclidinium cation (+1, 93.5% at pH 7.4 via pKa 8.56 PubChem AID 781325/781326 SID 103401549; 89.7% via 8.34 IUPAC 'perrin2958'; Merck pK1 5.07 quinoline / pK2 9.7). Quinine salts like CID 91558 (two-component hydrochloride) REJECTED per the bare-species law. Neutral CID 3034034 record stays in git history. AMENDED 2026-10-04 (human directive, 08.1-08 checkpoint finding 4): reference complex 9NDX -> 4WNV. Reason per human: 9NDX is a quinine-binding RNA aptamer - a NUCLEIC ACID reference class, wrong for an amino-acid game; must replace. 4WNV is the human-supplied candidate ('e.g. 4wnv ... or something else') and PASSES verification: Human Cytochrome P450 2D6 Quinine Complex (protein target); QI9 'Quinine' confirmed in the RCSB nonpolymer inventory (data API nonpolymer entity 3; HEM also present as entity 2, plus GOL/ZN/NA); entry DOI resolves (302 wwpdb); paper DOI https://doi.org/10.1074/jbc.M114.627661 resolves (302) and its CrossRef title 'Contributions of Ionic Interactions and Protein Dynamics to Cytochrome P450 2D6 (CYP2D6) Substrate and Inhibitor Binding' (Wang, Stout, Zhang, JBC 2015) matches the RCSB primary citation exactly - the paper DOI is no longer an honest absence. The prior 9NDX record stays in git history.
